page.layout: One printed page (left page of the opening is not shown; the right-hand printed page is the index). Running head at top centre; a title of two lines below it in italic; then two columns of index entries, left column and right column, from top to bottom. A narrow strip of show-through text at the right edge of the scan is not transcribed.

page.notes: The first line of the index's left column carries a large woodcut initial A. The right column's first entry is in Greek letters (ἐγαπᾶν). The "ἀταξία" entry on the left is Greek. The running head is taken from the printed title line. Some words are doubtful in the scan, such as "Alcibiades" and "Agathoclis", which are read as printed. The page continues at the foot with "Ale-" as a catchword-like break, which is transcribed as the last line.
